cohort: 141 pregnant women with heart disease (132 reaching 22 weeks gestation) and 264 matched healthy controls delivered between 2010 and 2018.
finding: Pregnant women with heart disease experienced increased maternal morbidity and higher rates of cesarean section and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with heart disease had significantly higher rates of cesarean section compared to healthy controls (OR 2.66).
followup_time: Up to the puerperium for mothers; at birth for newborns.
